canonical_title: Reuters reports expected year-end adoption of China's AI technology export control draft
aliases: China AI export controls October 16 draft
organizations: China Ministry of Science and Technology
treatment: Repeat only for concrete new policy, realized outcomes or independently verified implementation details.
known_facts: China's AI export control proposal was released on 2026-10-16; the underlying draft is not a 2026-10-28 announcement.
Reuters on 2026-10-28 at 07:17 UTC (16:17 JST) newly reported, citing an unnamed informed source, that China is expected to adopt the proposals by year-end and issue implementation guidance later.
The proposal would add 23 AI-related technologies to a restricted/banned technology export list; certain temporary registration obligations took effect on October 16.
The draft distinguishes overseas API/cloud access from transfer of model weights, underlying technology or overseas deployments; some transfers may require approval.
The reported adoption timeline is not a government-confirmed effective date.
reinclude_only_if: Official final rules or revisions and effective dates
Publication of implementing guidelines or definitive overseas deployment exemptions
Official changes to registration/licensing thresholds or affected models
notes: NEW in ledger only for newly sourced expected adoption timing, not a claim that the October 16 draft or temporary registration are new tonight. Year-end timeline is anonymous-source reporting.
